You overhear the following: 
“The cult of Aten are deluded fools. They serve semi-human 
monsters.” 
“Bodies have been seen carried to the eastern side of the 
pyramid at Tell-el-Amarna.” 
“Amet Keh served the cult, but they may dispose of him.” 
Return the café at 340, or the Fuzira Marketplace at 134.
